#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * probe-mcp-endpoint.mjs: what Tarsee's own loopback MCP endpoint (the Node version's src/ai/mcp-http.js) answers to
 * the three requests the real codex sends at the start of every turn (recorded in real/real-01-new-thread.json), sent
 * here with the same headers and bodies; and what it answers to a wrong token, a GET, and a revoked grant. The Rust
 * endpoint must give codex the same.
 *
 *   node probe-mcp-endpoint.mjs
 */
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const PROJECT = process.env.CAPTURE_PROJECT || "/path/to/the/node/checkout";
const SCRATCH = process.env.CAPTURE_SCRATCH || "/path/to/a/scratch/folder";
process.env.TARSEE_STATE_DIR = path.join(SCRATCH, "tarsee-state");
const from = (rel) => import(pathToFileURL(path.join(PROJECT, rel)).href);
const { startMcpHttp, grantTurn, stopMcpHttp } = await from("src/ai/mcp-http.js");

const stateDir = path.join(SCRATCH, "runs-other", "mcp-endpoint-state");
fs.mkdirSync(stateDir, { recursive: true });
await startMcpHttp({ stateDir });
const grant = await grantTurn({ conversationId: "capture", turnId: "capture-turn" }, { turnId: "capture-turn" });

const base = { "user-agent": "codex-mcp-client/0.167.0", accept: "text/event-stream, application/json", "content-type": "application/json", authorization: `Bearer ${grant.token}` };
const withVersion = { ...base, "mcp-protocol-version": "2025-06-18" };
const send = async (headers, body, method = "POST") => {
  const res = await fetch(grant.url, { method, headers, body: method === "POST" ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json = null;
  try { json = JSON.parse(text); } catch { /* not JSON */ }
  return { request: { method, headers, body }, answer: { status: res.status, headers: Object.fromEntries(res.headers.entries()), body: json ?? text } };
};

const out = {};
out.initialize = await send(base, { jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 0, method: "initialize", params: { protocolVersion: "2025-06-18", capabilities: { elicitation: { form: {}, url: {} } }, clientInfo: { name: "codex-mcp-client", title: "Codex", version: "0.167.0" } } });
out.initialized = await send(withVersion, { jsonrpc: "2.0", method: "notifications/initialized" });
out.toolsList = await send(withVersion, { jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/list", params: { _meta: { progressToken: 0 } } });
const tools = out.toolsList.answer.body?.result?.tools;
if (Array.isArray(tools)) out.toolsList.answer.body.result.tools = [tools[0], { "(capture note)": `${tools.length - 1} more tools, same shape`, names: tools.slice(1).map((t) => t.name) }];
out.wrongToken = await send({ ...withVersion, authorization: "Bearer wrong" }, { jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 2, method: "tools/list" });
out.getInsteadOfPost = await send(withVersion, null, "GET");
await grant.revoke();
out.afterTheGrantWasRevoked = await send(withVersion, { jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 3, method: "tools/list" });
await stopMcpHttp();

const fixture = {
  name: "other-06-tarsee-mcp-endpoint",
  what: "The answers of Tarsee's own MCP endpoint (Node version, src/ai/mcp-http.js) to codex's three start-of-turn requests, replayed with codex's headers; then a wrong token, a GET, and a request after the grant was revoked.",
  made_with: { endpoint: "src/ai/mcp-http.js startMcpHttp() + grantTurn()", platform: process.platform },
  ...out,
};
const text = JSON.stringify(fixture, null, 2).split(grant.token).join("<MCP_TOKEN>").replace(/127\.0\.0\.1:\d{4,5}/g, "127.0.0.1:<PORT>");
fs.mkdirSync(path.join(SCRATCH, "fixtures-other"), { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(SCRATCH, "fixtures-other", "other-06-tarsee-mcp-endpoint.json"), `${text}\n`);
console.log(`other-06-tarsee-mcp-endpoint: ${Object.entries(out).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v.answer.status}`).join(", ")}`);
process.exit(0);
